title: Diagnostic Performance of a Computer-aided System for Tuberculosis Screening in Two Philippine Cities
summary: The qXR3.0 system is assessed for TB screening in 82 participants against the Xpert assay reference, with reported sensitivity and specificity. The diagnostic result is limited to the study cohort, reference standard, and validation used.
organization: Royal Free London NHS Trust, London, United Kingdom
